verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs describe a Schedules capability in the Automation Platform for running recurring tasks, and say cloud agents can be triggered by schedules. This is a genuine recurring schedule, not a one-off run, but the documentation is only brief feature-level mentions. missing for 10: detailed docs on schedule configuration (cron/interval syntax, editing, pausing, failure handling), independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled runs

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Schedules: Run recurring tasks like dependency updates or dead code removal
Cloud agents are autonomous, background agents that run on Warp’s cloud infrastructure or your own, triggered by system events, schedules, or integrations like Slack and GitHub.
The Automation Platform runs cloud agents from triggers, schedules, integrations, and APIs.
